CustomField.description: The normalized postal code, a bar and the first street word normalization leaves as written, for example 02139|77 (D-200 P6). Set on every save by BarnCRM so duplicate matching reads addresses through this index instead of searching every street. Written by BarnCRM only; there is no reason to edit it by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by BarnCRM on every save, so duplicate matching can find this address quickly.
CustomField.label: Match Key
